analytical_question: Even if autonomous AI agents are an attractive solution for internal request triage, can this bank absorb, govern and sustain a 90-day controlled pilot?
general_et_finding: Autonomous AI agents may coordinate multi-step work and human review, but actual reliability, security and integration performance must be demonstrated for the intended configuration. The two organizations do not change these general technology uncertainties. Technology maturity is not inferred from either bank’s readiness.
application_finding: The same bounded internal triage-and-draft application is plausibly suitable for controlled evaluation, provided the assistant uses approved knowledge, role-appropriate access, traceable logs, clear escalation and human authorization before sensitive actions. This is application suitability for a test, not proof of production effectiveness or compliance.
value_opportunity_implication: Potential lower repetitive handling effort, more consistent triage and faster internal turnaround; benefits remain hypotheses until measured against a human-operated baseline.
risk_governance_implication: Human approval, least-privilege access, audit traces, incident escalation and tested rollback must precede any live sensitive action. Model-generated guidance cannot replace accountable bank signoff.
organization_specific_finding:
Readiness verdict: NOT READY TO DEPLOY (including a live pilot). Application fit is potentially favorable, but organizational execution readiness is not. Eight-dimension profile:
1. Leadership/sponsorship — HIGH: interested innovation lead; no executive decision sponsor.
2. Skills/training — HIGH: two analysts trained; frontline users and escalation staff unprepared.
3. Workflow/process — HIGH: exception ownership and signoff undefined.
4. Infrastructure/data — CRITICAL: sandbox peak-load failed; knowledge access labels inconsistent.
5. Resources/budget — CRITICAL: only trial funding; no funded maintenance/monitoring.
6. Governance/risk — HIGH: draft logging; security review and rollback incomplete.
7. Culture/change — MODERATE: staff accountability concerns; no feedback mechanism.
8. Operating ownership — CRITICAL: no named accountable service owner.
Prioritized gates: (P0) IT platform owner and data/security lead must demonstrate capped-load retest and verified role-based access; (P0) CFO/finance with operations sponsor must approve recurring support funding and assign named service owner; (P0) risk/security must sign off escalation, audit, incident and rollback tests; (P1) operations head must document exception pathways and train pilot staff. Owners are recommended functions, not confirmed appointments.

evidence.claim: Peak-load sandbox test failed and access labels are inconsistent
evidence.evidence_type: Hypothetical case assumption; not independently validated
evidence.notes: Scenario support for infrastructure blocker, not a real bank test report

evidence.claim: Recurring support budget and named service owner absent
evidence.evidence_type: Hypothetical case assumption; not independently validated
evidence.notes: Continuity gap remains even if model performs acceptably

evidence.claim: Exception workflow and security rollback incomplete
evidence.evidence_type: Hypothetical case assumption; not independently validated

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: Two analysts are trained and one-off pilot funds exist; these strengths do not remove critical blockers.
No audited test logs, staffing rosters or budget documents supplied.
confidence_and_uncertainty: High confidence in the conditional scenario-based NOT READY classification given its stipulated failures; low confidence about any actual bank because all facts are hypothetical and unverified. The general technology capability is not independently tested in this exercise.
recommendation_management_implication: Do not initiate a live pilot. Prioritize (1) load/access control remediation and documented test pass by IT/security, (2) funded recurring support and named service ownership approved by finance/COO, and (3) exception, incident, audit and rollback signoff by operations/risk. Reassess readiness only after gate evidence is provided.
change_monitoring_triggers: Capped-load and access-control retest passes with recorded owner signoff.
Signed recurring support plan and accountable operating owner are documented.
Security review, exception SOP and rollback rehearsal are completed.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Provide the peak-load retest report, approved access-control test results, signed support-budget plan and service owner assignment before any live-pilot decision.
